attrs.note: R7.3. GPT-5.6 proposed demoting the channel catalog to descriptive coverage on the grounds that the architectural law, not the list, is the theorem. The list is not descriptive: it is what the law quantifies over, so demoting it silently would have left the universal unbounded. SRC-BATES-2015-LPM is the demonstration that this is how the property is actually stated in practice — whole-system provenance complete over CONTROLLED DATA TYPES, inherited from a verified lower monitor, with the residual relocated to attestation rather than closed. The honest discharge route here is the same reduction, and this tree has no runtime to reduce to. The tenth channel, `external_side_inputs`, is a catch-all, and a catch-all inside a quantifier domain declares that the domain is open rather than closing it. That is not recorded as a `residual` entry because residuals resolve to open defeater ids and this is a property of the universe itself, not an attack on it.
attrs.statement: The ten declared channels exhaust the effect-relevant inputs to an admitted inference transition: there is no eleventh way for the outside to reach the result.
